_README: Curated alignment EQUIP-GATES: base-item name -> list of alignments allowed to equip it. Exclude-until-verified — add an item ONLY when the DDO wiki explicitly states an alignment equip restriction (NOT a conditional bonus like 'Required Trait: Lawful (UMD +20)', which is a bonus, not a gate). Keys beginning with '_' are ignored. Empty until wiki-verified curation (see plan U3 / Outstanding Questions).
